description.es: Marta sueña con reencontrarse con Fina, quien le confiesa estar desahuciada, pero la ilusión se convierte en pesadilla al vivir su muerte en sueños. Espantada despierta en el despacho de Damián, quién la consuela. Marta le confiesa que dejará todo para viajar a Buenos Aires en busca de Fina, incapaz de soportar la incertidumbre y frustrada por la falta de avances. Damián intenta detenerla, pero Marta ya ha tomado su decisión.
description.en: Marta dreams of being reunited with Fina, who confesses she is terminally ill, but the dream turns into a nightmare as she lives through Fina's death in her sleep. Horrified, she wakes up in Damián's office, where he comforts her. Marta confesses that she will drop everything to travel to Buenos Aires in search of Fina, unable to bear the uncertainty and frustrated by the lack of progress. Damián tries to stop her, but Marta has already made up her mind.
